items.q: What broke at Harvey after 10,000 agent PRs?
items.a: Not the agents—**everything around them**: checkout, capacity, merging.

items.q: Why run agents in the cloud instead of laptops?
items.a: Laptops top out at **5-10 agents**; the cloud brings **secrets, the real stack** and fair capacity.

items.q: Which single stage would Joey build first?
items.a: A **follow-up loop** that reads CI failures and **pushes another fix**.

items.q: What rule opened Spectre to other agents?
items.a: **If a person can click it, an agent can call it**—everything via CLI.

items.q: Where does tribal testing knowledge live?
items.a: In **shared project pages** that any agent reads.

items.q: How did one bug launch ~900 agents?
items.a: An alert per workspace **tagged the agent every time**; fix: repeat alerts **join the open investigation**.

items.q: What fixed one user flooding the cluster?
items.a: A **fair launch queue**: place in line, humans first, fair share with borrowing.

items.q: What guardrail do automations get on day one?
items.a: They **switch off after five failures in a row**, with a budget or expiry date.
